name: Hearts
overview: Scripture reveals that the heart is the center of human character and spiritual condition, as God searches and judges it according to one’s deeds (Jeremiah 17:10). God promises to transform hardened, stony hearts into hearts of flesh by giving a new spirit and a clean, pure heart (Ezekiel 11:19; 36:26; Psalms 51:10). This inward renewal is essential for true righteousness and blessing, as those who are pure in heart shall see God (Matthew 5:8). The study of hearts includes understanding brokenness and hardness, emphasizing the need for divine regeneration and continual cleansing.
